Settings.StoreRefHint: Reference to the hidden JournalEntry used as the narrative database.
Settings.ThemeHint: Switches between light and dark mode on the smartphone interface.
Settings.PinHint: The PIN protects the phone from other players. It is not a barrier against the GM, nor against whoever administers the server.
Settings.NotificationSoundHint: Mutes or restores phone sounds (notifications and typing).
Settings.ReducedEffectsHint: Minimizes animations in the phone interface.
Settings.TimezoneHint: IANA time zone for the world clock (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo). Empty uses each player's time zone.
Settings.DisplayYearHint: Replaces the real year on the phone. 0 keeps the real year.
Settings.EraHint: Narrative era shown next to the year (e.g. AC, Space Era).
Settings.DefaultWallpaperHint: Wallpaper applied to every phone with no personal choice.
Settings.DebugLoggingHint: Enables detailed Lumenn logs in the browser console.
Settings.DefaultThemeHint: Theme applied to players who have not picked their own.
Settings.DefaultNotificationSoundHint: Turns sound on or off for players who have not chosen.
Settings.LimitStoreHint: How many notifications are kept per character before the oldest are dropped.
Settings.LimitTtlDaysHint: Days until a notification expires. 0 disables expiry.
Settings.FlagKeypressSoundHint: Plays a sound on every key typed on the phone.
Settings.FlagNotificationBannerHint: Shows the banner when a notification arrives.
Settings.FlagPlayerWallpaperUploadHint: Lets the player upload an image from their own computer.
